alsoKnownAs.name: Turbinado sugar
alsoKnownAs.note: The name the same partly-refined cane sugar is usually sold under there; the crystals are often finer.

forms.sourceNote: Sugar, turbinado. Public domain. FoodData Central carries no separate demerara record; the two are the same partly-refined cane sugar, differing in crystal size rather than in composition. The density is the solid-sugar class, not the record's teaspoon figure, which measures packing.
